title: Finance ON shows the Finance pages, and Integrations ON shows QuickBooks, IBS and Open API
preconds: 1. A user has a role with Settings ON, App Settings ON, and both Finance and Integrations sub-toggles ON.
steps:
1. Log in as that user and open the Settings area.
  2. Look at the Finance pages.
  3. Look at the Integrations pages.
expected:
The Finance pages are shown, including Payment Methods and Taxes.

The Integrations pages are shown: QuickBooks, IBS and Open API.
